messages:
sana (People Ops): Quick heads-up — handbook v3.2 is published (PTO accrual tweaks + remote-office security addendum). We need brief manager-led micro-training (10–15m) for all ICs and contractors. Please sign your team up here: https://docs.example.com/sheets/handbook-v3-signups (deadline: Fri 2026-04-10). Add attendee list to the tracker.
jonathan (Eng Manager): Added my team. Do we need slides or can I run from notes?
mia (HR Ops): We have a 6-slide deck in Drive and a 5-question quiz (auto-grades). Drive: https://drive.example.com/handbook-v3-mini-deck
luis (People Ops - Compliance): Note: completion flagged in payroll sync; teams without completion might have delayed PTO changes. Please mark completions in the tracker column `training_done`.
olivia (People Ops): I'll update the handbook page with a short changelog and link to the deck. Publishing now.
rebecca (People Ops Coordinator): I can own the AM live slots this week — will post calendar invites once folks pick times in the sheet.
reminder-bot: Reminder set — signup sheet lock in 48h.
talent-sr: Are contractors/temps required too? Some vendors overlap with product teams.
sana (People Ops): Yes — contractors who are in our org tree should complete. For external vendors, ask partner owner to confirm. We also have a recorded self-serve session for off-hours teams: https://videos.example.com/handbook-v3-recording
jonathan (Eng Manager): :thumbsup: I'll push invites to my managers.
mia (HR Ops): Quick ask — please add a CSV row for each attendee with `email,role,manager` into the tracker (copy-paste works). Example: `jane@example.com,Senior Engineer,Jonathan`
luis (People Ops - Compliance): Also flag any exemptions in the tracker (medical accommodations, LOA) in the `exemption_reason` column.
rebecca (People Ops Coordinator): Anyone want me to run a short office hours Q&A after the micro-training? 30 min block tomorrow 3pm PT.
talent-sr: I'll drop a note to recruitment to include the training link in offer packages for new hires starting Q2.
sana (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Final checklist: 1) sign up team, 2) add attendee CSV rows, 3) run or assign micro-training, 4) mark `training_done` when complete. Ping me for exceptions.
